items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I played opposite him in Philadelphia, so I got to hear him a whole lot.

ctx.x: Dexter Gordon turned me on to something about Lester. Before Lester was in the Army, Dexter got ahold of all his tapes. If you get a chance, and you want to know about it, tell Dex you want to hear his tapes. He got tapes of Lester Young before the sergeants beat him up for finding a white woman's picture in his pocket.
Oh, yeah, I heard about that.
